passages.heading: Speaking truth to power . . . for the people
passages.text: María Elvira Salazar is the daughter of Cuban exiles who fled communism in search of freedom and opportunity. Before serving in Congress, she was an award-winning journalist who challenged dictators, exposed corruption, and reported from across Latin America. Today, she fights for South Florida families by strengthening the economy, improving healthcare, supporting public safety, and defending the freedoms that make America exceptional.

passages.heading: Infrastructure
passages.text: As your representative in Congress, I have secured millions of dollars in federal funding to modernize and strengthen South Florida’s infrastructure. My work has delivered critical investments in flood mitigation, stormwater management, road and bridge improvements, water and sewer upgrades, coastal resilience, and port infrastructure. From expanding Port of Miami’s capacity and reducing emissions to replacing aging water systems, improving mobility corridors, and protecting neighborhoods from flooding, these projects are making our communities safer, more resilient, and better prepared for future growth.

passages.heading: Infrastructure
passages.text: I remain committed to ensuring South Florida has the modern infrastructure needed to support a strong economy, protect our quality of life, and meet the challenges of the 21st century.

passages.heading: Anti-Socialism
passages.text: As your representative in Congress, I have been one of the strongest voices in Washington against socialism, communism, and authoritarian regimes. Having witnessed firsthand the devastation these ideologies have caused across Latin America, I have led the fight to defend freedom, democracy, and human rights. I have held congressional hearings exposing the abuses of the Cuban, Maduro, and Ortega regimes, championed sanctions against dictators and their enablers, and fought to keep pressure on those who oppress their own people.

passages.heading: Anti-Socialism
passages.text: I have also spoken out against attacks on free speech and democratic institutions in countries like Brazil and worked to ensure transparency and accountability in elections across the region, including Honduras. From passing legislation to strengthen America's response to authoritarian threats to standing with political prisoners and pro-democracy activists, my commitment is unwavering: defending liberty, confronting tyranny, and ensuring the voices of those fighting for freedom are heard.

passages.heading: Economy & Jobs
passages.text: As your representative in Congress, I am working to create more opportunities for South Florida families, support local businesses, and keep our economy strong. I have voted to lower taxes, supported efforts to provide greater tax relief for working families, and fought to help small businesses grow and create jobs. I have also worked to recover billions of taxpayer dollars lost to fraud and waste during the pandemic, helping bring greater accountability to government spending and reduce inflationary pressures.

passages.heading: Economy & Jobs
passages.text: In addition, I have secured funding for workforce training programs and hosted five major job fairs, connecting thousands of South Florida residents with employers and helping people find good jobs close to home. My focus is simple: creating opportunity, supporting workers and small businesses, and building a stronger economy for every family in South Florida.

passages.heading: Term Limits
passages.text: We must get rid of career politicians in both parties that put profits and power above people, and we must set limits on how long public servants can serve in Washington. Our Founding Fathers intended it to be: public service, not a career. Today, Washington is full of career politicians who have lost touch with their constituents, who believe their primary objective is to get re-elected. They enrich themselves and cultivate powerful connections that in turn fund their campaigns.

passages.heading: Affordable Healthcare
passages.text: As your representative in Congress, I am committed to strengthening our healthcare system and ensuring patients have access to the care they need. I have secured millions of dollars to expand healthcare services, strengthen hospitals, support groundbreaking medical research, and improve access to care for children, seniors, and underserved communities. I have helped expand mental health services for children, supported advances in cancer research and personalized medicine, and worked to ensure families have access to the treatments they need.

passages.heading: Affordable Healthcare
passages.text: I also fought to protect and preserve programs that train the next generation of doctors, helping expand the healthcare workforce and improve access to care in communities that need it most. In addition, I have helped seriously ill children receive life-saving medical treatment in Miami and championed policies that put patients and families first. My goal is simple: to improve access to care, strengthen our healthcare system, and help every family live healthier lives.

passages.heading: Protect the Environment
passages.text: As a proud champion of the Everglades, I am fully committed to securing funding for its restoration and preservation, ensuring this unique ecosystem is protected for generations to come. I am leading the charge to create a National Resilience Strategy, designed to safeguard our coastal communities from the increasing threats of hurricanes, storm surges, and rising sea levels. I’ve secured millions of dollars through Community Funding Projects for Florida’s 27th district to build critical stormwater infrastructure, reduce flooding, and improve water quality in Biscayne Bay.

passages.heading: Protect the Environment
passages.text: Additionally, I passed legislation to support coral reef restoration, including the transformation of retired Navy ships into artificial reefs, which not only strengthens our marine ecosystems but also boosts local economies and recreational opportunities. From combating harmful algae blooms to advocating for clean water initiatives, my focus remains on protecting our environment and enhancing Florida’s natural resources for a sustainable future.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar Bio
passages.text: Born in Miami’s Little Havana to Cuban parents, who emigrated to the United States, fleeing Cuba due to the arrival of Fidel Castro to power. With only five dollars in their pockets, the pursuit for freedom and the American dream was instilled in María Elvira Salazar at an early age by her parents. While being raised in Miami and Puerto Rico, Salazar listened as her parents told stories of the oppressive communist regime from which they escaped. Becoming American citizens at the Freedom Tower, Salazar’s parents wanted a better life for their family; they wanted freedom.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: That pursuit of freedom and the American Dream shaped Maria Elvira Salazar’s early life and career, and it continues to drive her today. Salazar graduated from the University of Miami and later from Harvard University which she paid for herself. She began a career in journalism covering local stories for Univision.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: A rising star in the field of journalism, Salazar’s career took her all over the world. She became the anchor for CNN Español, the first time a major news network had a broadcast fully in Spanish. Salazar then covered the White House and the Gulf War. It was in her next assignment where Salazar witnessed firsthand the price for freedom.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: Working again for Univision, Salazar covered the Salvadoran Civil War. She was embedded on the frontlines. She saw the crossfire from the opposing factions. She felt the fear of war. Though at times Salazar came under circumstances where her own life was in danger, she left El Salvador after the war and used the contacts made there to begin reporting in Cuba.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: In Cuba, she witnessed the atrocities of the Castro communist government but could not just stand by. Through her reporting, she became a leading voice against Fidel Castro, pointing out the actions of the government and its devastating effects on the people of Cuba. Eventually, Salazar became too vocal for the likes of Castro and the Cuban government.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: It was her persistence and passion to uncover the truth in defense of freedom that led to the interview of a lifetime. After years in pursuit and a direct confrontation with him in New York, Salazar was granted an interview with Fidel Castro.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: Salazar would go on to be a national news anchorwoman at Telemundo and have a long run with her own top-rated show on Mega TV. Winning five Emmy Awards, she was recognized for her passion for freedom and uncovering oppressive, communist and socialist regimes in Latin America especially in Cuba, Venezuela, and Nicaragua.

passages.heading: Maria Elvira Salazar is in Congress fighting to stop socialism from ever coming and ruining America.
passages.text: In her career Salazar has interviewed a wide range of social and political leaders, including Presidents Bill Clinton, George W. Bush, Alvaro Uribe, Jose Maria Aznar, Vicente Fox, Juan Manuel Santos, Augusto Pinochet, Nicolas Maduro and, more recently, Juan Guaidó.

passage.heading: Below are some of my key accomplishments:
passage.text: Supporting the Fiscal Responsibility Act: I backed the Fiscal Responsibility Act, which cuts over $2 trillion in spending, reclaims $28 billion in unspent COVID funds, and expands welfare work requirements. This historic measure aims to be the largest deficit reduction bill ever.

passage.heading: Affordable Healthcare
passage.text: As your representative in Congress, I am committed to strengthening our healthcare system and ensuring patients have access to the care they need. I have secured millions of dollars to expand healthcare services, strengthen hospitals, support groundbreaking medical research, and improve access to care for children, seniors, and underserved communities. I have helped expand mental health services for children, supported advances in cancer research and personalized medicine, and worked to ensure families have access to the treatments they need.

passage.heading: Affordable Healthcare
passage.text: I also fought to protect and preserve programs that train the next generation of doctors, helping expand the healthcare workforce and improve access to care in communities that need it most. In addition, I have helped seriously ill children receive life-saving medical treatment in Miami and championed policies that put patients and families first. My goal is simple: to improve access to care, strengthen our healthcare system, and help every family live healthier lives.

passage.heading: Protect the Environment
passage.text: As a proud champion of the Everglades, I am fully committed to securing funding for its restoration and preservation, ensuring this unique ecosystem is protected for generations to come. I am leading the charge to create a National Resilience Strategy, designed to safeguard our coastal communities from the increasing threats of hurricanes, storm surges, and rising sea levels. I’ve secured millions of dollars through Community Funding Projects for Florida’s 27th district to build critical stormwater infrastructure, reduce flooding, and improve water quality in Biscayne Bay.

passage.heading: Here are some of my key accomplishments:
passage.text: Introduced the National Climate Adaptation and Resilience Strategy Act: This creates a comprehensive plan for strengthening our resilience against hurricane damage, storm surges, and flooding, while safeguarding Florida’s most vulnerable natural treasures, including the Everglades.

passage.heading: Anti-Socialism
passage.text: I have also spoken out against attacks on free speech and democratic institutions in countries like Brazil and worked to ensure transparency and accountability in elections across the region, including Honduras. From passing legislation to strengthen America's response to authoritarian threats to standing with political prisoners and pro-democracy activists, my commitment is unwavering: defending liberty, confronting tyranny, and ensuring the voices of those fighting for freedom are heard.

passage.heading: “As your representative in Congress, I understand the profound impact that totalitarian and socialist regimes have had on our South Florida community. That’s why I am committed to being a strong advocate against these oppressive regimes.” – María Elvira Salazar Here are some of my key accomplishments:
passage.text: Introduced Legislation to Restore Democracy and Accountability in Venezuela: I proposed support for international efforts to address the Maduro regime’s crimes and provide relief to Venezuelans suffering from a prolonged political and economic crisis.
